```{r}
#match metabolites between metabolic dataset and mv loadings
known <- mv2_loadings_nna_unk_sig[,1] #mv5
metabolites <- metab$Metabolites

# Safe parsing function
parse_entry_safe <- function(entry) {
  entry <- iconv(entry, to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte")
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(entry, "_"))
  if (length(parts) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  name <- paste0(parts[1:(length(parts) - 2)], collapse = "_")
  mass <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[length(parts) - 1]))
  rt <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[length(parts)]))
  
  if (is.na(mass) || is.na(rt)) return(NULL)
  
  return(list(name = gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", name), mass = mass, rt = rt))
}

# Parse known and metabolites
known_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(known, parse_entry_safe))
metabolites_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(metabolites, parse_entry_safe))

# Convert to data frames
known_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, known_list), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
metabolites_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, metabolites_list), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Ensure numeric
known_df$mass <- as.numeric(known_df$mass)
known_df$rt <- as.numeric(known_df$rt)
metabolites_df$mass <- as.numeric(metabolites_df$mass)
metabolites_df$rt <- as.numeric(metabolites_df$rt)

# Thresholds
delta_mass <- 0.02
delta_rt <- 0.1

# Find matching indices in metabolites for each known
matched_indices <- sapply(1:nrow(known_df), function(i) {
  matches <- which(abs(known_df$mass[i] - metabolites_df$mass) <= delta_mass &
                   abs(known_df$rt[i] - metabolites_df$rt) <= delta_rt)
  if (length(matches) > 0) return(matches[1]) else return(NA)
})

# Output: indices of first match for each known in metabolites
print(matched_indices)


head(metab[matched_indices,1:5])

metab_matched <- metab[matched_indices,]
dim(metab_matched)
```

```{r}
#save effect sizes
# Initialize
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# Set seed for reproducibility
#set.seed(4424)
set.seed(442)

# Convert PNI to binary
metab_clin$PNI <- ifelse(tolower(metab_clin$perineural_invasion) == "yes", 1, 0)

# Define metabolite columns
start_col <- which(names(metab_clin) == "Butyric acid_88.05_3.29") #MV2
#start_col <- which(names(metab_clin) == "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_2.84") #MV6
metabolite_names <- names(metab_clin)[start_col:ncol(metab_clin)]

# Exclude PNI from the metabolite list
metabolite_names <- setdiff(metabolite_names, "PNI")

# Initialize results storage
all_results <- data.frame(
  Iteration = integer(),
  Metabolite = character(),
  Estimate = numeric(),
  P_value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Track warnings
perfect_fit_count <- 0
warning_metabolites <- character()
   

# Run 1000 iterations
for (i in 1:1000) {
  idx <- sample(1:nrow(metab_clin), size = 0.7 * nrow(metab_clin))
  train <- metab_clin[idx, ]
  
  for (met in metabolite_names) {
    model <- lm(train[[met]] ~ train$PNI)
    
     is_perfect <- FALSE
    
    sm <- withCallingHandlers(
      summary(model),
      warning = function(w) {
        if (grepl("essentially perfect fit", w$message)) {
          perfect_fit_count <<- perfect_fit_count + 1
          warning_metabolites <<- c(warning_metabolites, met)
         is_perfect <<- TRUE
        }
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    )
    
    if (!is.na(coef(sm)[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]) && !is_perfect) {
      est <- coef(sm)[2, "Estimate"]
      pval <- coef(sm)[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
      
      
      all_results <- rbind(all_results, data.frame(
        Iteration = i,
        Metabolite = met,
        Estimate = est,
        P_value = pval
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Report total warning count
cat("Number of 'essentially perfect fit' warnings:", perfect_fit_count, "\n")

# Summarize results
summary_df <- all_results %>%
  group_by(Metabolite) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Estimate = mean(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Estimate = sd(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_logP = mean(-log10(P_value), na.rm = TRUE),
    Freq_Sig = mean(P_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Significance_Level = case_when(
    Freq_Sig > 0.2 ~ ">20%",
    Freq_Sig > 0.1 ~ "10–20%",
    TRUE ~ "<=10%"
  ))

# Fix encoding and clean names
summary_df$Metabolite <- iconv(summary_df$Metabolite, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte")
summary_df$Clean_Name <- sub("_.*", "", summary_df$Metabolite)
summary_df$Clean_Name <- str_wrap(summary_df$Clean_Name, width = 20)

# Plot with horizontal line at 0
#pdf("5D_20260501_COLOSSUS_phenmap_PNI_MV2_MV6_metabolite_association_1000_iterations.pdf")

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = reorder(Clean_Name, Mean_Estimate), y = Mean_Estimate, color = Significance_Level)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(size = Freq_Sig)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_Estimate - SD_Estimate, ymax = Mean_Estimate + SD_Estimate), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Metabolite Effects on PNI (1000 Iterations)",
    x = "Metabolite", y = "Mean Linear Estimate",
    size = "Significance Frequency", color = "Significance Level"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(">20%" = "firebrick", "10–20%" = "orange", "<=10%" = "gray60")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
#dev.off()

# selected metabolites
sel <- which(summary_df$Significance_Level == "10–20%" | summary_df$Significance_Level == ">20%")

mm <- match(summary_df$Metabolite[sel], metab_matched$Metabolites)
metab_matched_sel <- metab_matched[mm,]
dim(metab_matched_sel)

```

```{r}
# proteins ~ PNI + metabolites with stratified 70/30 train-test validation
# Models with perfect separation are excluded
set.seed(121)

protein_exp <- read.delim("20200928_metabolomics_median_replicates_data_80_Non_zero_sample_median_centred_imputed_MARS_combat_lysis_batch.txt",
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dim(protein_exp)

# keep only proteins with SD > 0
protein_numeric <- protein_exp
protein_numeric[, -1] <- lapply(protein_numeric[, -1, drop = FALSE], as.numeric)

ssdp <- apply(protein_numeric[, , drop = FALSE], 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
w_ssdp <- which(ssdp > 0.5)
length(w_ssdp)

protein_exp_sd <- protein_numeric[w_ssdp, ]
dim(protein_exp_sd)

# 1. Transpose protein matrix: make samples rows, proteins columns
protein_long <- as.data.frame(t(protein_exp_sd))
protein_long$sample_id <- rownames(protein_long)

# 2. Fix sample ID format to match metab_clin_sel$COLOSSUS_ID
# If protein colnames are like COL.268.R.001_FP_001, convert to COL-268-R-001
protein_long$COLOSSUS_ID <- substr(gsub("\\.", "-", protein_long$sample_id), 1, 13)

# 3. Subset metabolite columns of interest
#selected_mets <- summary_df$Metabolite[sel]
selected_mets <- c(
  "Butyric acid_88.05_3.29",
  #"(S)-2-Methylbutanoic acid_102.07_3.09",
  #"2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_3.42",
  "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_3.59",
  #"Ketoleucine_130.06_2.98",
  "2-Methylbenzoic acid_136.05_3.07",
 # "Hydrocinnamic acid_150.07_2.96",
  "4-Ethyloctanoic acid_172.15_2.92",
  "Galactitol_182.08_12.08"#,
  #"Palmitic acid_256.24_2.91"
)

#remove Fumaric acid
#fum <- grep("Fumaric acid_116.01_12.64",summary_df$Metabolite[sel])
#selected_mets <- selected_mets[-fum]
#length(selected_mets)
selected_mets


colnames(metab_clin_sel) <- iconv(colnames(metab_clin_sel), to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
selected_mets <- iconv(selected_mets, to = "UTF-8", sub = "")

met_cols <- unlist(lapply(selected_mets, function(x) {
  grep(
    paste0("^", gsub("([][{}()+*^$.|\\\\?])", "\\\\\\1", x), "$|^",
           gsub("([][{}()+*^$.|\\\\?])", "\\\\\\1", x), "_"),
    colnames(metab_clin_sel),
    value = TRUE
  )
}))
met_cols <- unique(met_cols)

#metab_clin_sel$PNI <- metab_clin_sel$perineural_invasion
metab_clin$PNI <- metab_clin$perineural_invasion

# merge
#combined_data <- merge(
#  protein_long,
#  metab_clin_sel[, c("COLOSSUS_ID", "PNI", met_cols), drop = FALSE],
#  by = "COLOSSUS_ID"
#)

# merge
combined_data <- merge(
  protein_long,
  metab_clin[, c("COLOSSUS_ID", "PNI", met_cols), drop = FALSE],
  by = "COLOSSUS_ID"
)

dim(combined_data)

# make sure PNI is numeric 0/1
#combined_data$PNI <- as.numeric(as.character(combined_data$PNI))
combined_data$PNI <- ifelse(
  tolower(trimws(combined_data$PNI)) == "yes", 1,
  ifelse(tolower(trimws(combined_data$PNI)) == "no", 0, NA)
)

table(combined_data$PNI, useNA = "ifany")

table(combined_data$PNI)

protein_names <- setdiff(colnames(protein_long), c("sample_id", "COLOSSUS_ID"))
metabolite_names <- met_cols

model_grid <- expand.grid(
  protein = protein_names,
  metabolite = metabolite_names,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# parameters
n_iter <- 100
p_thresh <- 0.05

all_results_list <- list()

skip_counts <- c(
  too_few_rows = 0,
  single_pni_class = 0,
  train_model_fail = 0,
  test_model_fail = 0,
  perfect_fit_train = 0,
  perfect_fit_test = 0,
  no_interaction_train = 0,
  no_interaction_test = 0,
  non_finite_interaction_train = 0,
  non_finite_interaction_test = 0
)

for (i in 1:n_iter) {
  cat("Iteration:", i, "\n")
  
  # stratified split by PNI
  idx_pni0 <- which(combined_data$PNI == 0)
  idx_pni1 <- which(combined_data$PNI == 1)
  
  n_train0 <- max(2, floor(0.7 * length(idx_pni0)))
  n_train1 <- max(2, floor(0.7 * length(idx_pni1)))
  
  train_idx0 <- sample(idx_pni0, size = n_train0, replace = FALSE)
  train_idx1 <- sample(idx_pni1, size = n_train1, replace = FALSE)
  
  train_idx <- c(train_idx0, train_idx1)
  test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(combined_data)), train_idx)
  
  train_data <- combined_data[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  test_data  <- combined_data[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  iter_results <- list()
  
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(model_grid))) {
    protein <- model_grid$protein[j]
    metabolite <- model_grid$metabolite[j]
    
    # training data
    df_train <- train_data[, c(protein, "PNI", metabolite), drop = FALSE]
    colnames(df_train) <- c("protein_val", "PNI", "met_val")
    
    df_train$protein_val <- as.numeric(df_train$protein_val)
    df_train$PNI <- as.numeric(df_train$PNI)
    df_train$met_val <- as.numeric(df_train$met_val)
    
    df_train <- df_train[
      complete.cases(df_train) &
        is.finite(df_train$protein_val) &
        is.finite(df_train$met_val),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    
    # test data
    df_test <- test_data[, c(protein, "PNI", metabolite), drop = FALSE]
    colnames(df_test) <- c("protein_val", "PNI", "met_val")
    
    df_test$protein_val <- as.numeric(df_test$protein_val)
    df_test$PNI <- as.numeric(df_test$PNI)
    df_test$met_val <- as.numeric(df_test$met_val)
    
    df_test <- df_test[
      complete.cases(df_test) &
        is.finite(df_test$protein_val) &
        is.finite(df_test$met_val),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    
    if (nrow(df_train) <= 4 || nrow(df_test) <= 4) {
      skip_counts["too_few_rows"] <- skip_counts["too_few_rows"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    if (length(unique(df_train$PNI)) < 2 || length(unique(df_test$PNI)) < 2) {
      skip_counts["single_pni_class"] <- skip_counts["single_pni_class"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    model_train <- tryCatch(
      lm(protein_val ~ PNI * met_val, data = df_train),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(model_train)) {
      skip_counts["train_model_fail"] <- skip_counts["train_model_fail"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    model_test <- tryCatch(
      lm(protein_val ~ PNI * met_val, data = df_test),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(model_test)) {
      skip_counts["test_model_fail"] <- skip_counts["test_model_fail"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    sm_train <- summary(model_train)
    sm_test  <- summary(model_test)
    
    # remove perfect / saturated / unusable fits
    if (df.residual(model_train) <= 0 ||
        !is.finite(sm_train$r.squared) ||
        sm_train$r.squared >= 0.9999) {
      skip_counts["perfect_fit_train"] <- skip_counts["perfect_fit_train"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    if (df.residual(model_test) <= 0 ||
        !is.finite(sm_test$r.squared) ||
        sm_test$r.squared >= 0.9999) {
      skip_counts["perfect_fit_test"] <- skip_counts["perfect_fit_test"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    summ_train <- sm_train$coefficients
    summ_test  <- sm_test$coefficients
    
    if (!("PNI:met_val" %in% rownames(summ_train))) {
      skip_counts["no_interaction_train"] <- skip_counts["no_interaction_train"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    if (!("PNI:met_val" %in% rownames(summ_test))) {
      skip_counts["no_interaction_test"] <- skip_counts["no_interaction_test"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    est_train  <- summ_train["PNI:met_val", "Estimate"]
    pval_train <- summ_train["PNI:met_val", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    r2_train   <- sm_train$r.squared
    
    est_test  <- summ_test["PNI:met_val", "Estimate"]
    pval_test <- summ_test["PNI:met_val", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    r2_test   <- sm_test$r.squared
    
    if (!is.finite(est_train) || !is.finite(pval_train)) {
      skip_counts["non_finite_interaction_train"] <- skip_counts["non_finite_interaction_train"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    if (!is.finite(est_test) || !is.finite(pval_test)) {
      skip_counts["non_finite_interaction_test"] <- skip_counts["non_finite_interaction_test"] + 1
      next
    }
    
    sig_train <- ifelse(!is.na(pval_train) && pval_train < p_thresh, 1, 0)
    sig_test  <- ifelse(!is.na(pval_test) && pval_test < p_thresh, 1, 0)
    
    same_sign <- ifelse(
      !is.na(est_train) && !is.na(est_test) && sign(est_train) == sign(est_test),
      1, 0
    )
    
    validated_direction <- ifelse(sig_train == 1 && same_sign == 1, 1, 0)
    validated_strict    <- ifelse(sig_train == 1 && sig_test == 1 && same_sign == 1, 1, 0)
    
    iter_results[[length(iter_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      iteration = i,
      protein = protein,
      metabolite = metabolite,
      estimate_train = est_train,
      pval_train = pval_train,
      r2_train = r2_train,
      estimate_test = est_test,
      pval_test = pval_test,
      r2_test = r2_test,
      significant_train = sig_train,
      significant_test = sig_test,
      same_sign = same_sign,
      validated_direction = validated_direction,
      validated_strict = validated_strict,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  if (length(iter_results) > 0) {
    all_results_list[[length(all_results_list) + 1]] <- do.call(rbind, iter_results)
  }
}

all_results <- do.call(rbind, all_results_list)

if (is.null(all_results) || nrow(all_results) == 0) {
  stop("No valid train-test interaction results were generated. Inspect skip_counts.")
}

summary_stats <- all_results %>%
  group_by(protein, metabolite) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested = n(),
    n_train_hits = sum(significant_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_test_hits = sum(significant_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_same_sign = sum(same_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_validated_direction = sum(validated_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_validated_strict = sum(validated_strict, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_train = mean(significant_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_test = mean(significant_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_same_sign = mean(same_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_validated_direction = mean(validated_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_validated_strict = mean(validated_strict, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_estimate_train = mean(estimate_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_estimate_train = median(estimate_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_estimate_test = mean(estimate_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_estimate_test = median(estimate_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pval_train = mean(pval_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pval_train = median(pval_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pval_test = mean(pval_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pval_test = median(pval_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r2_train = mean(r2_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r2_test = mean(r2_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(frequency_validated_direction),
          desc(frequency_train),
          median_pval_train)

print(skip_counts)
print(summary_stats)

# recommended primary hits:
summary_stats_sig <- summary_stats %>%
  filter(frequency_train >= 0.6,
         frequency_validated_direction >= 0.6) %>%
  arrange(desc(frequency_validated_direction),
          desc(frequency_train),
          median_pval_train)

print(summary_stats_sig)
length(unique(summary_stats_sig$protein))
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Simplified train/test interaction stability loop
## =========================================================

# proteins ~ PNI + metabolites with stratified 70/30 train-test validation
# Models with perfect separation are excluded
set.seed(121)

protein_exp <- read.delim("20200928_metabolomics_median_replicates_data_80_Non_zero_sample_median_centred_imputed_MARS_combat_lysis_batch.txt",
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dim(protein_exp)

# keep only proteins with SD > 0
protein_numeric <- protein_exp
protein_numeric[, -1] <- lapply(protein_numeric[, -1, drop = FALSE], as.numeric)

ssdp <- apply(protein_numeric[, , drop = FALSE], 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
w_ssdp <- which(ssdp > 0.5)
length(w_ssdp)

protein_exp_sd <- protein_numeric[w_ssdp, ]
dim(protein_exp_sd)

# 1. Transpose protein matrix: make samples rows, proteins columns
protein_long <- as.data.frame(t(protein_exp_sd))
protein_long$sample_id <- rownames(protein_long)

# 2. Fix sample ID format to match metab_clin_sel$COLOSSUS_ID
# If protein colnames are like COL.268.R.001_FP_001, convert to COL-268-R-001
protein_long$COLOSSUS_ID <- substr(gsub("\\.", "-", protein_long$sample_id), 1, 13)

# 3. Subset metabolite columns of interest
#selected_mets <- summary_df$Metabolite[sel]
#selected_mets <- summary_df$Metabolite[sel]
selected_mets <- c(
  "Butyric acid_88.05_3.29",
  #"(S)-2-Methylbutanoic acid_102.07_3.09",
  #"2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_3.42",
  "2-Ethylhydracrylic acid_118.06_3.59",
  #"Ketoleucine_130.06_2.98",
  "2-Methylbenzoic acid_136.05_3.07",
 # "Hydrocinnamic acid_150.07_2.96",
  "4-Ethyloctanoic acid_172.15_2.92",
  "Galactitol_182.08_12.08"#,
  #"Palmitic acid_256.24_2.91"
)

#remove Fumaric acid
fum <- grep("Fumaric acid_116.01_12.64",summary_df$Metabolite[sel])
selected_mets <- selected_mets[-fum]
length(selected_mets)
selected_mets


colnames(metab_clin_sel) <- iconv(colnames(metab_clin_sel), to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
selected_mets <- iconv(selected_mets, to = "UTF-8", sub = "")

met_cols <- unlist(lapply(selected_mets, function(x) {
  grep(
    paste0("^", gsub("([][{}()+*^$.|\\\\?])", "\\\\\\1", x), "$|^",
           gsub("([][{}()+*^$.|\\\\?])", "\\\\\\1", x), "_"),
    colnames(metab_clin_sel),
    value = TRUE
  )
}))
met_cols <- unique(met_cols)

#metab_clin_sel$PNI <- metab_clin_sel$perineural_invasion
metab_clin$PNI <- metab_clin$perineural_invasion

# merge
#combined_data <- merge(
#  protein_long,
#  metab_clin_sel[, c("COLOSSUS_ID", "PNI", met_cols), drop = FALSE],
#  by = "COLOSSUS_ID"
#)

# merge
combined_data <- merge(
  protein_long,
  metab_clin[, c("COLOSSUS_ID", "PNI", met_cols), drop = FALSE],
  by = "COLOSSUS_ID"
)

dim(combined_data)

# make sure PNI is numeric 0/1
#combined_data$PNI <- as.numeric(as.character(combined_data$PNI))
combined_data$PNI <- ifelse(
  tolower(trimws(combined_data$PNI)) == "yes", 1,
  ifelse(tolower(trimws(combined_data$PNI)) == "no", 0, NA)
)

table(combined_data$PNI, useNA = "ifany")

table(combined_data$PNI)

protein_names <- setdiff(colnames(protein_long), c("sample_id", "COLOSSUS_ID"))
metabolite_names <- met_cols

model_grid <- expand.grid(
  protein = protein_names,
  metabolite = metabolite_names,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# parameters
n_iter <- 100
p_thresh <- 0.05

all_results_list <- list()

skip_counts <- c(
  too_few_rows = 0,
  single_pni_class = 0,
  train_model_fail = 0,
  test_model_fail = 0,
  perfect_fit_train = 0,
  perfect_fit_test = 0,
  no_interaction_train = 0,
  no_interaction_test = 0,
  non_finite_interaction_train = 0,
  non_finite_interaction_test = 0
)


for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
  
  cat("Iteration:", i, "\n")
  
  ## Stratified split by PNI
  idx0 <- which(combined_data$PNI == 0)
  idx1 <- which(combined_data$PNI == 1)
  
  train_idx <- c(
    sample(idx0, size = max(2, floor(0.7 * length(idx0))), replace = FALSE),
    sample(idx1, size = max(2, floor(0.7 * length(idx1))), replace = FALSE)
  )
  
  test_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(combined_data)), train_idx)
  
  train_data <- combined_data[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  test_data  <- combined_data[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  iter_results <- list()
  
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(model_grid))) {
    
    protein    <- model_grid$protein[j]
    metabolite <- model_grid$metabolite[j]
    
    ## Build clean train/test data
    df_train <- data.frame(
      protein_val = as.numeric(train_data[[protein]]),
      PNI         = as.numeric(train_data$PNI),
      met_val     = as.numeric(train_data[[metabolite]])
    )
    
    df_test <- data.frame(
      protein_val = as.numeric(test_data[[protein]]),
      PNI         = as.numeric(test_data$PNI),
      met_val     = as.numeric(test_data[[metabolite]])
    )
    
    df_train <- df_train[complete.cases(df_train), , drop = FALSE]
    df_test  <- df_test[complete.cases(df_test), , drop = FALSE]
    
    ## Minimal safety checks
    if (nrow(df_train) <= 4 || nrow(df_test) <= 4) next
    if (length(unique(df_train$PNI)) < 2 || length(unique(df_test$PNI)) < 2) next
    
    ## Fit train and test models
    fit_train <- tryCatch(
      lm(protein_val ~ PNI * met_val, data = df_train),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    fit_test <- tryCatch(
      lm(protein_val ~ PNI * met_val, data = df_test),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (is.null(fit_train) || is.null(fit_test)) next
    if (df.residual(fit_train) <= 0 || df.residual(fit_test) <= 0) next
    
    sm_train <- summary(fit_train)
    sm_test  <- summary(fit_test)
    
    if (!is.finite(sm_train$r.squared) || sm_train$r.squared >= 0.9999) next
    if (!is.finite(sm_test$r.squared)  || sm_test$r.squared  >= 0.9999) next
    
    coef_train <- sm_train$coefficients
    coef_test  <- sm_test$coefficients
    
    if (!"PNI:met_val" %in% rownames(coef_train)) next
    if (!"PNI:met_val" %in% rownames(coef_test)) next
    
    est_train  <- coef_train["PNI:met_val", "Estimate"]
    pval_train <- coef_train["PNI:met_val", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    r2_train   <- sm_train$r.squared
    
    est_test  <- coef_test["PNI:met_val", "Estimate"]
    pval_test <- coef_test["PNI:met_val", "Pr(>|t|)"]
    r2_test   <- sm_test$r.squared
    
    if (!is.finite(est_train) || !is.finite(pval_train)) next
    if (!is.finite(est_test)  || !is.finite(pval_test)) next
    
    sig_train <- as.integer(pval_train < p_thresh)
    sig_test  <- as.integer(pval_test  < p_thresh)
    same_sign <- as.integer(sign(est_train) == sign(est_test))
    
    iter_results[[length(iter_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      iteration = i,
      protein = protein,
      metabolite = metabolite,
      estimate_train = est_train,
      pval_train = pval_train,
      r2_train = r2_train,
      estimate_test = est_test,
      pval_test = pval_test,
      r2_test = r2_test,
      significant_train = sig_train,
      significant_test = sig_test,
      same_sign = same_sign,
      validated_direction = as.integer(sig_train == 1 && same_sign == 1),
      validated_strict = as.integer(sig_train == 1 && sig_test == 1 && same_sign == 1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  if (length(iter_results) > 0) {
    all_results_list[[length(all_results_list) + 1]] <- do.call(rbind, iter_results)
  }
}

all_results <- do.call(rbind, all_results_list)

if (is.null(all_results) || nrow(all_results) == 0) {
  stop("No valid train-test interaction results were generated. Inspect skip_counts.")
}

summary_stats <- all_results %>%
  group_by(protein, metabolite) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested = n(),
    n_train_hits = sum(significant_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_test_hits = sum(significant_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_same_sign = sum(same_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_validated_direction = sum(validated_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_validated_strict = sum(validated_strict, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_train = mean(significant_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_test = mean(significant_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_same_sign = mean(same_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_validated_direction = mean(validated_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    frequency_validated_strict = mean(validated_strict, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_estimate_train = mean(estimate_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_estimate_train = median(estimate_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_estimate_test = mean(estimate_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_estimate_test = median(estimate_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pval_train = mean(pval_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pval_train = median(pval_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pval_test = mean(pval_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pval_test = median(pval_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r2_train = mean(r2_train, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r2_test = mean(r2_test, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(frequency_validated_direction),
          desc(frequency_train),
          median_pval_train)

print(skip_counts)
print(summary_stats)

# recommended primary hits:
summary_stats_sig <- summary_stats %>%
  filter(frequency_train >= 0.6,
         frequency_validated_direction >= 0.6) %>%
  arrange(desc(frequency_validated_direction),
          desc(frequency_train),
          median_pval_train)

print(summary_stats_sig)
length(unique(summary_stats_sig$protein))
```

```{r}
## ============================================
## Enrichr-based MSigDB Hallmark enrichment
## using only proteins with positive direction
## from summary_stats_sig
## ============================================

## Install if needed
# install.packages(c("enrichR", "dplyr", "stringr", "ggplot2", "readr"))

library(enrichR)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

## --------------------------------------------
## 1. Select only positive-direction proteins
## --------------------------------------------
## Selection rule:
## keep proteins with positive median interaction estimate in train
## and, if available, also positive in test

if ("median_estimate_test" %in% colnames(summary_stats_sig)) {
  positive_hits <- summary_stats_sig %>%
    filter(median_estimate_train > 0,
           median_estimate_test > 0)
} else {
  positive_hits <- summary_stats_sig %>%
    filter(median_estimate_train > 0)
}

#if ("median_estimate" %in% colnames(summary_stats_sig)) {
 # positive_hits <- summary_stats_sig %>%
  #  filter(median_estimate > 0)
#} else {
 # positive_hits <- summary_stats_sig %>%
 #   filter(median_estimate > 0)
#}


positive_proteins <- unique(positive_hits$protein)

cat("Number of positive-direction protein entries:", length(positive_proteins), "\n")
print(positive_proteins)

## --------------------------------------------
## 2. Convert protein entries to gene symbols
## --------------------------------------------
## Examples:
## "P11172_UMPS"             -> "UMPS"
## "P06731;P40198_CEACAM5"   -> "CEACAM5"
## "Q14699;Q52LD8_RFTN1"     -> "RFTN1"
## "P99999;CON__P62894_CYCS" -> "CYCS"

extract_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- sub("^CON__", "", x)
  x <- sub("^.*__", "", x)
  gene <- sub("^.*_", "", x)
  gene <- trimws(gene)
  if (is.na(gene) || gene == "") return(NA_character_)
  gene
}

gene_symbols <- vapply(positive_proteins, extract_gene_symbol, character(1))
gene_symbols <- sort(unique(gene_symbols[!is.na(gene_symbols) & gene_symbols != ""]))

cat("Number of unique positive-direction gene symbols:", length(gene_symbols), "\n")
print(gene_symbols)

## --------------------------------------------
## 3. Output directory
## --------------------------------------------
out_dir <- "own_script"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## Save selected proteins
write.table(
  data.frame(Protein = positive_proteins),
  file = file.path(out_dir, "positive_direction_protein_entries.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

## Save gene symbols
write.table(
  data.frame(Gene = gene_symbols),
  file = file.path(out_dir, "positive_direction_gene_symbols.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

## --------------------------------------------
## 4. Find Hallmark database in Enrichr
## --------------------------------------------
dbs <- enrichR::listEnrichrDbs()

hallmark_db_candidates <- dbs$libraryName[
  grepl("hallmark", dbs$libraryName, ignore.case = TRUE)
]

cat("Hallmark-like databases found:\n")
print(hallmark_db_candidates)

if (length(hallmark_db_candidates) == 0) {
  stop("No Hallmark-like Enrichr database found. Check listEnrichrDbs().")
}

preferred_idx <- grep("msigdb.*hallmark|hallmark.*msigdb",
                      hallmark_db_candidates,
                      ignore.case = TRUE)

if (length(preferred_idx) >= 1) {
  hallmark_db <- hallmark_db_candidates[preferred_idx[1]]
} else {
  hallmark_db <- hallmark_db_candidates[1]
}

cat("Using Enrichr database:", hallmark_db, "\n")

## --------------------------------------------
## 5. Run Enrichr enrichment
## --------------------------------------------
enrichr_res <- enrichR::enrichr(
  genes = gene_symbols,
  databases = hallmark_db
)

hallmark_res <- enrichr_res[[hallmark_db]]

if (is.null(hallmark_res) || nrow(as.data.frame(hallmark_res)) == 0) {
  stop("No enrichment results returned.")
}

## --------------------------------------------
## 6. Clean results
## --------------------------------------------
hallmark_res_clean <- as.data.frame(hallmark_res, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

hallmark_res_clean$minus_log10_adj_p <- -log10(hallmark_res_clean$Adjusted.P.value)
hallmark_res_clean$overlap_genes_n <- sub("/.*$", "", hallmark_res_clean$Overlap)

hallmark_res_clean <- hallmark_res_clean[
  order(hallmark_res_clean$Adjusted.P.value),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

print(hallmark_res_clean)

## Save full results
write.table(
  hallmark_res_clean,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "positive_direction_Enrichr_MSigDB_Hallmark_results.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

## Save significant results
hallmark_sig <- hallmark_res_clean %>%
  filter(Adjusted.P.value < 0.05)

write.table(
  hallmark_sig,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "positive_direction_Enrichr_MSigDB_Hallmark_results_FDRlt0.05.txt"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

## --------------------------------------------
## 7. Plot top enriched Hallmark terms
## --------------------------------------------
if (nrow(hallmark_res_clean) > 0) {
  
  top_n <- min(15, nrow(hallmark_res_clean))
  
  plot_df <- hallmark_res_clean[seq_len(top_n), , drop = FALSE]
  plot_df$Term <- factor(plot_df$Term, levels = rev(plot_df$Term))
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = minus_log10_adj_p, y = Term, size = Combined.Score)) +
    geom_point() +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = "MSigDB Hallmark enrichment (positive-direction proteins)",
      x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      y = "",
      size = "Combined score"
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, "positive_direction_Enrichr_MSigDB_Hallmark_dotplot.pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 6
  )
}

## --------------------------------------------
## 8. Optional: print enriched terms clearly
## --------------------------------------------
cat("\nTop enriched Hallmark terms:\n")
print(
  hallmark_res_clean[, c("Term", "Overlap", "Adjusted.P.value", "Combined.Score")],
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nDone.\n")
cat("Results saved in:", out_dir, "\n")
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Enrichr-based enrichment analysis

tg_candidates <- dbs$libraryName[grepl("tg", dbs$libraryName, ignore.case = TRUE) |
                                   grepl("gates", dbs$libraryName, ignore.case = TRUE)]

pwm_candidates <- dbs$libraryName[grepl("transfac", dbs$libraryName, ignore.case = TRUE) |
                                    grepl("jaspar", dbs$libraryName, ignore.case = TRUE) |
                                    grepl("pwm", dbs$libraryName, ignore.case = TRUE)]

encode_candidates <- dbs$libraryName[grepl("encode", dbs$libraryName, ignore.case = TRUE) |
                                    grepl("chea", dbs$libraryName, ignore.case = TRUE) |
                                    grepl("chipx", dbs$libraryName, ignore.case = TRUE)]


cat("\nTG-GATEs-like candidates:\n")
print(tg_candidates)

cat("\nTRANSFAC/JASPAR/PWM-like candidates:\n")
print(pwm_candidates)

## Prefer exact-like matches if present
pick_first_match <- function(candidates, priority_patterns = NULL) {
  if (length(candidates) == 0) return(character(0))
  
  if (!is.null(priority_patterns)) {
    for (pat in priority_patterns) {
      idx <- grep(pat, candidates, ignore.case = TRUE)
      if (length(idx) > 0) return(candidates[idx[1]])
    }
  }
  
  candidates[1]
}

tg_db <- pick_first_match(
  tg_candidates,
  priority_patterns = c("tg.*gates", "gates", "tg")
)

#pwm_db <- pick_first_match(
  #pwm_candidates,
 # priority_patterns = c("transfac.*jaspar.*pwms",
 #                       "transfac.*jaspar",
 #                       "jaspar.*pwms",
 #                       "pwms",
 #                       "transfac",
  #                      "jaspar")
#)

pwm_db <- pick_first_match(
  encode_candidates,
  priority_patterns = c("encode.*chea.*consensus.*tfs.*pwms",
                        "encode.*chea",
                        "consensus.*tfs",
                        "tfs",
                        "encode",
                        "chea")
)


selected_dbs <- c(tg_db, pwm_db)
selected_dbs <- selected_dbs[selected_dbs != ""]

cat("\nSelected databases:\n")
print(selected_dbs)

if (length(selected_dbs) == 0) {
  stop("No TG-GATEs or ENCODE_and_ChEA_Consensus_TFs_from_ChIP-X PWM database could be identified from Enrichr.")
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 5. Run Enrichr
## ---------------------------------------------------------
enrichr_res <- enrichR::enrichr(
  genes = gene_symbols,
  databases = selected_dbs
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Helper function to clean result tables
## ---------------------------------------------------------
clean_enrichr_table <- function(res_table, db_name) {
  if (is.null(res_table)) return(NULL)
  
  df <- as.data.frame(res_table, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df$Database <- db_name
  
  if ("Adjusted.P.value" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$minus_log10_adj_p <- -log10(df$Adjusted.P.value)
    df <- df[order(df$Adjusted.P.value), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  if ("Overlap" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$overlap_n <- sub("/.*$", "", df$Overlap)
  }
  
  df
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 7. Clean and save each database result
## ---------------------------------------------------------
all_clean_results <- list()

for (db_name in selected_dbs) {
  cat("\nProcessing:", db_name, "\n")
  
  res_table <- enrichr_res[[db_name]]
  clean_table <- clean_enrichr_table(res_table, db_name)
  
  if (is.null(clean_table) || nrow(clean_table) == 0) {
    cat("No results returned for", db_name, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  all_clean_results[[db_name]] <- clean_table
  
  safe_db_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", db_name)
  
  write.table(
    clean_table,
    file = file.path(out_dir, paste0("Enrichr_", safe_db_name, "_results.txt")),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  if ("Adjusted.P.value" %in% colnames(clean_table)) {
    sig_table <- clean_table %>%
      filter(Adjusted.P.value < 0.05)
    
    write.table(
      sig_table,
      file = file.path(out_dir, paste0("Enrichr_", safe_db_name, "_results_FDRlt0_05.txt")),
      sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 8. Plot top terms for each database
## ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_top_terms <- function(df, db_name, out_dir, top_n = 15) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (!("minus_log10_adj_p" %in% colnames(df))) return(NULL)
  
  top_n <- min(top_n, nrow(df))
  plot_df <- df[seq_len(top_n), , drop = FALSE]
  plot_df$Term <- factor(plot_df$Term, levels = rev(plot_df$Term))
  
  if ("Combined.Score" %in% colnames(plot_df)) {
    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = minus_log10_adj_p, y = Term, size = Combined.Score)) +
      geom_point() +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      labs(
        title = db_name,
        x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
        y = "",
        size = "Combined score"
      )
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = minus_log10_adj_p, y = Term)) +
      geom_point() +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      labs(
        title = db_name,
        x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
        y = ""
      )
  }
  
  print(p)
  
  safe_db_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", db_name)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("Enrichr_", safe_db_name, "_dotplot.pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 6
  )
  
  invisible(p)
}

for (db_name in names(all_clean_results)) {
  plot_top_terms(all_clean_results[[db_name]], db_name, out_dir, top_n = 15)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 9. Combined summary table
## ---------------------------------------------------------
if (length(all_clean_results) > 0) {
  combined_results <- bind_rows(all_clean_results)
  
  write.table(
    combined_results,
    file = file.path(out_dir, "Enrichr_TGGATES_TRANSFAC_JASPAR_combined_results.txt"),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  combined_sig <- combined_results
  
  if ("Adjusted.P.value" %in% colnames(combined_sig)) {
    combined_sig <- combined_sig %>%
      filter(Adjusted.P.value < 0.05)
    
    write.table(
      combined_sig,
      file = file.path(out_dir, "Enrichr_TGGATES_TRANSFAC_JASPAR_combined_results_FDRlt0_05.txt"),
      sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 10. Print concise summaries
## ---------------------------------------------------------
for (db_name in names(all_clean_results)) {
  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Top results for:", db_name, "\n")
  cat("==============================\n")
  
  df <- all_clean_results[[db_name]]
  
  cols_to_show <- intersect(
    c("Term", "Overlap", "Adjusted.P.value", "Combined.Score"),
    colnames(df)
  )
  
  print(utils::head(df[, cols_to_show, drop = FALSE], 10), row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("\nDone.\n")
cat("Results saved in:\n", out_dir, "\n")
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Clean Train vs Test scatter plot with correct labelling
## =========================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)
library(scales)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Output directory
## ---------------------------------------------------------
out_dir_main <- "own_script"
dir.create(out_dir_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Check required objects
## ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("summary_stats"))
stopifnot(exists("summary_stats_sig"))

required_cols_summary <- c(
  "protein", "metabolite",
  "mean_estimate_train", "mean_estimate_test",
  "median_pval_train",
  "frequency_train", "frequency_validated_direction"
)

missing_summary <- setdiff(required_cols_summary, colnames(summary_stats))
if (length(missing_summary) > 0) {
  stop("summary_stats is missing required columns: ",
       paste(missing_summary, collapse = ", "))
}

required_cols_sig <- c("protein", "metabolite")
missing_sig <- setdiff(required_cols_sig, colnames(summary_stats_sig))
if (length(missing_sig) > 0) {
  stop("summary_stats_sig is missing required columns: ",
       paste(missing_sig, collapse = ", "))
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Helper functions for metabolite labels
## ---------------------------------------------------------
extract_metabolite_parts <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- iconv(x, to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(x, "_", fixed = TRUE))

  if (length(parts) >= 3) {
    list(
      name = paste(parts[1:(length(parts) - 2)], collapse = "_"),
      mass = parts[length(parts) - 1],
      rt   = parts[length(parts)]
    )
  } else {
    list(
      name = x,
      mass = NA_character_,
      rt   = NA_character_
    )
  }
}

clean_metabolite_name <- function(x) {
  p <- extract_metabolite_parts(x)
  nm <- p$name
  nm <- gsub("^X\\.*", "", nm)
  nm <- gsub("\\.", " ", nm)
  nm <- gsub("_", " ", nm)
  nm <- gsub("\\s+", " ", nm)
  trimws(nm)
}

metabolite_label_exact <- function(x, digits_mass = 2, digits_rt = 2) {
  p <- extract_metabolite_parts(x)
  nm <- clean_metabolite_name(x)

  mass_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p$mass))
  rt_num   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p$rt))

  mass_txt <- if (!is.na(mass_num)) format(round(mass_num, digits_mass), nsmall = digits_mass) else p$mass
  rt_txt   <- if (!is.na(rt_num))   format(round(rt_num, digits_rt),   nsmall = digits_rt)   else p$rt

  if (!is.na(mass_txt) && !is.na(rt_txt) && nzchar(mass_txt) && nzchar(rt_txt)) {
    paste0(nm, " [m/z ", mass_txt, ", RT ", rt_txt, "]")
  } else {
    nm
  }
}

make_hit_label <- function(protein, metabolite, width = 34) {
  met_lab <- metabolite_label_exact(metabolite)
  met_lab <- stringr::str_trunc(met_lab, width = width, side = "right")
  paste0(protein, "\n", met_lab)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 4. Build plotting data
## ---------------------------------------------------------
sig_keys <- unique(paste(summary_stats_sig$protein, summary_stats_sig$metabolite, sep = "___"))

plot_df <- summary_stats %>%
  mutate(
    protein = as.character(protein),
    metabolite = as.character(metabolite),
    clean_met = vapply(metabolite, clean_metabolite_name, character(1)),
    exact_met_label = vapply(metabolite, metabolite_label_exact, character(1)),
    hit_label = mapply(make_hit_label, protein, metabolite, USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    recommended_hit = paste(protein, metabolite, sep = "___") %in% sig_keys,
    endpoint_score = abs(mean_estimate_train) + abs(mean_estimate_test)
  )

## optional safety filters
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(mean_estimate_train),
    is.finite(mean_estimate_test),
    is.finite(frequency_validated_direction)
  )

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 5. Label data:
## label only recommended hits, but avoid repeated-looking labels
## keep the best row per protein + cleaned metabolite name
## ---------------------------------------------------------
label_df <- plot_df %>%
  filter(recommended_hit) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(endpoint_score),
    desc(frequency_validated_direction),
    desc(frequency_train),
    median_pval_train
  ) %>%
  distinct(protein, clean_met, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Plot
## ---------------------------------------------------------
p_train_test <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = mean_estimate_train, y = mean_estimate_test)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = frequency_validated_direction),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_df %>% filter(recommended_hit),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "#F1D302",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.7,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = hit_label),
    size = 3.2,
    color = "black",
    box.padding = 0.40,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 121
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("#2c7fb8", "#7b3294", "#d7191c"),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
    name = "Freq.\nvalidated"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Train vs Test Estimates – Recommended Hits Highlighted",
    x = "Mean interaction estimate (train)",
    y = "Mean interaction estimate (test)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95")
  )

print(p_train_test)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
```
